responsibility: Implements the bootstrapped GNU Modula-2 ASCII runtime companion module as generated code, defining the standard ASCII control and printable character constants used throughout the pge-boot libraries and providing empty module init/fini entry points for runtime registration. It does not perform I/O or transformation itself; its role is to centralize stable character-code definitions such as NUL, LF, CR, TAB, DEL, and aliases like EOL for other string, scanner, and terminal modules.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated companion implementation for the ASCII module: it duplicates the character-code macros locally and provides the module's _M2_ASCII_init/_fini entry points. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GASCII.h, it is not the include-facing declaration file used by other modules.
